Issue #65: Conduct intra-dataset analysis

Link: https://github.com/Break-Through-Tech/Automation-Anywhere-2A-evaluation-framework-for-synthetic-agent-benchmark-datasets/tree/65-conduct-intra-dataset-analysis/results/domain_analysis

- Domain profiles for all 3 τ²-bench domains and 7 synthetic agents: workflow completeness, entropy, Coverage, v1.1 designed Difficulty and the #62 50/50 composite
- Airline vs retail: Coverage favors airline (0.962 vs 0.905), Difficulty favors retail (64.87 vs 59.10), and the composites are nearly equal (77.62 vs 77.67)
- Checked against the frozen coverage CSV, the 342 task scores, and the 50/114/114 dataset mean (64.1547)
- Outputs for #66: domain_profiles.csv, tau2_domain_profiles.png, provenance.json and a README with findings and limitations

@bondmila @sanagrao6 @anjanakummetha this is ready for #66.
